brief: A bright, daylit pharmacy with a long white dispensing counter with a green base band and LED underglow across the back, fronted by a full-height white backbar of medicine shelving. Free-standing white gondolas with green plinths and glass-edged shelves of boxed and bottled products run down the open pale floor, with wall gondolas on both side walls. A waiting zone of green upholstered bench seats sits in the left corner beside a tall window and a framed leaf print. Potted and hanging plants soften the clinical white, and recessed LED panels light the whole room evenly. Surfaces carry computer monitors, small plants and product displays.

must_have.where: free-standing white and green aisle units down the centre-left of the floor
along the left and right side walls
full-width medicine shelving behind the dispensing counter
long dispensing counter across the back
left side by the window, a row of four green seats
by the window and the waiting area

concept: A clean, clinical-fresh pharmacy where white surfaces, apple-green accents, even daylight-white LED light and plants signal trust, health and ease of navigation.
relations: White panels + pale speckled floor + 4000K flush LED panels + window daylight = shadowless, hygienic, high-visibility retail
Apple-green accent bands on counter base, gondola plinths and seating tie the zones together and act as brand colour
Dense colourful product packaging is the only colour on neutral white shelving, so the products become the decor
Low gondolas keep sightlines open to the dispensing counter, while the waiting bench sits apart by the window
Plants and a leaf print soften the clinical grid and reinforce the green wellness concept
not_reproducible: Actual medicine boxes and brand packaging, staff and customers, computer screens and POS hardware, the view of trees outside the window, ceiling air vents and signage.
